# Fixture for BP-PY-41 (safe) — assertion helpers, not bare side effects

# find_object_with raising AssertionError.
lang: python
file: test_compliance_safe.py

import unittest


class TestPDFA4Compliance(unittest.TestCase):
    def _assert_verapdf_compliant(self, fixture_name: str) -> None:
        result_code = 0
        stdout = 'isCompliant="true" failedRules="0"'
        self.assertEqual(result_code, 0, fixture_name)
        self.assertIn('isCompliant="true"', stdout)
        self.assertIn('failedRules="0"', stdout)

    def test_minimal_text_passes_pdfa4(self) -> None:
        self._assert_verapdf_compliant("minimal-text")


def find_object_with(data: bytes, marker: bytes, offsets: dict) -> int:
    for obj_id, offset in offsets.items():
        if marker in data[offset : offset + 64]:
            return obj_id
    raise AssertionError(f"no object contains {marker!r}")


class TestShellObjects(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_catalog_and_pages_present(self) -> None:
        data = b"/Type /Catalog"
        offsets = {1: 0}
        for marker in (b"/Type /Catalog", b"/Type /Pages /", b"/Type /Page /"):
            find_object_with(data, marker, offsets)
